name: Imp guard
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, wearing a dented helmet of cooled black slag with a glowing orange crack in it and a short slag-iron spear, a smouldering ember cupped in the other clawed hand, no sack

poses.stand: hovering upright on spread bat wings, spear held level at its side, the ember held up ready to throw
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: breathes and shifts its weight in place, its glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: plants itself in the air, rears back and flings three embers forward to the right in a fan from its hand, then hovers again

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
